moves.name: Eternal Power!
moves.description: Reduces the user’s sync move countdown by 1. Raises the user’s Sp. Atk by 3 stat ranks. Applies the Supereffective ↑ Next effect to the user. Lowers the user’s Sp. Def by 1 stat rank.

passives.name: Eternal Champion
passives.description: When the user’s max move attacks an opponent, the target becomes all opposing sync pairs. The power of max moves affected by this passive skill is not lowered even if there are multiple targets. Increases the user’s Special Moves ↑ Next effect by 3 ranks after using its max move. Increases the user’s Sync Move ↑ Next effect by 5 ranks after using its max move.

subPassives.name: Targets Maxed
subPassives.description: When the user’s max move attacks an opponent, the target becomes all opposing sync pairs. The power of max moves affected by this passive skill is not lowered even if there are multiple targets.

subPassives.description: Increases the user’s Special Moves ↑ Next effect by 3 rank(s) after using its max move.

subPassives.name: Max Move: Sync Move Boost 5
subPassives.description: Increases the user’s Sync Move ↑ Next effect by 5 rank(s) after using its max move.

passives.name: Lucky Seven 4
passives.description: Has a chance (50%) of lowering the target’s Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, Speed, accuracy, and evasiveness by one stat rank when the user’s attack move against it is successful.

passives.name: MAX Damage Guard
passives.description: Applies the Damage Guard Next effect to the user after using its max move. (If hit by an attack while this effect is applied, the attack will inflict no damage on the user, while the damage of some attacks such as sync moves will be halved. The effect is removed after it is activated.)
